engine: bydorr's signature text reveal — a multi-line passage that, on scroll, reveals CHARACTER BY CHARACTER from left to right as a SMOOTH BASELINE-LOCKED WAVE: the settled head is solid, while the chars at the reveal EDGE are a translucent horizontal SMEAR (extra letter-spacing + slight rightward x-drift + slight shrink + fade) that COLLAPSES to settled as the wave passes. NO vertical move, NO rotation -> stable + liquid. A scroll-scrubbed per-glyph collapse-settle. Harvested from D_bydorr (the 'Feel because you have a heart... laugh, love, and sleep.' poem reveal).

measured_teardown.move: one pinned scroll-scrub, progress p 0..1. The text is split into per-character spans (spaces preserved). Each char i owns a window [i/N*spread .. +charWin] along p (left-to-right cascade, spread = 1-charWin). Inside its window the char eases (power3.out) from an unsettled edge state to settled, via a BASELINE-LOCKED HORIZONTAL COLLAPSE: opacity 0.10->1; letterSpacing (inv^2)*(0.08+0.20k) em -> 0 (tracking tightens FASTER than the fade); translate3d X = inv*(chaos*0.13 + chaos*0.32k) px rightward -> 0 (Y and Z pinned to 0); scale 1-inv*(0.06+0.05k) -> 1 (slight shrink, never >1, no pop). NO translateY, NO rotation at any p (verified 0.00px vertical move). Per-char variety from a deterministic seed c.__k in [0,1] scaling magnitude only (never motion direction). FIX HISTORY: the original build scattered chars with random +/-chaos dx/dy + rotation -> letters teleported vertically (unstable); replaced with this collapse model after a 4-agent fidelity workflow against the bydorr reference.
measured_teardown.cited: bydorr: 'Feel because you have a heart / And let it guide you through the dark / For it's the well of emotions deep / That helps you laugh, love, and sleep.' — head solid, edge characters jumbled/rotating into place, revealed left-to-right as you scroll; a faint X/Y crosshair readout + a 'W.' honors marker sit alongside (not part of this brick).

chaos.what: scales the edge x-smear (rightward drift = inv*(chaos*0.13 + chaos*0.32*k) px) — NOT a 2D scatter anymore (no Y, no rotation). Bigger = a longer horizontal smear tail. ~30-40 reads like bydorr.

charWin.what: fraction of total progress each char takes to collapse (its window length). Larger = a gentler, more liquid glide (raised from 0.10 to smooth the wave); the cascade spread = 1-charWin.

pinFactor.what: length of the pinned scroll span = how long the whole passage takes to assemble.

seed.what: deterministic scramble seed — same seed => same per-char scramble vectors (stable, no jitter).

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when the page drives a shared Lenis (lab sets false).

entry: ScrambleSettleText.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), chars, destroy }. target = .sst-stage wrapping .sst-text (plain text, or [data-line] blocks for explicit lines). The JS splits the text into .sst-char spans. set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub (0 all scrambled, 1 all settled).
law: transform: translate3d X + scale per char + opacity + letterSpacing only; GPU (X/Y/Z translate composited); NO translateY, NO rotation, NO filter / NO mix-blend; NO WebGL; reduced-motion or <=820px -> all settled (no pin). owns_pin TRUE. Seeds (c.__k) are deterministic (PRNG seeded once) — never Math.random per frame. GSAP + ScrollTrigger required for the scroll path; set(p) standalone.
gate_mode: owns_pin scroll-scrub. Verify the LEFT-TO-RIGHT edge: at a mid p the head chars are settled (opacity 1, transform 0, letter-spacing 0) while the edge chars are a translucent rightward smear with extra tracking; the tail is faint. CRITICAL STABILITY GATE: maxVerticalMove == 0 and NO rotation at any p (the original build failed here — it scattered vertically). Smoothness with the full char count transforming per frame.
proven: lab: a 4-line UA passage (62 chars) on white paper. STABILITY verified: maxVerticalMove = 0.00px, anyRotation = false across p in {0,0.25,0.5,0.75}; all chars settle to opacity 1 + scale(1) + letterSpacing 0 at p=1. Curve: the reveal edge advances left-to-right (head settled while the tail is a translucent rightward smear). Mid-reveal screenshot: lines 1-2 solid, line 3 'Де ра[н о к — це вікн о]' with the edge glyphs as a baseline-locked translucent smear with extra letter-spacing collapsing in (1:1 with bydorr's 'Feel because yo[u h a v e]' horizontal smear — NO vertical jump). Probe (4x CPU throttle, 62 chars/frame incl. letterSpacing reflow): 1/618 long frames (0.2%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors. (Tuned via a 4-agent fidelity workflow vs the bydorr reference; collapse-tracking model won over scatter/rotate.)
